name: Tuck Jump
steps: Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly bent, and arms held ready at your sides.
Drop quickly into a shallow quarter squat while swinging your arms back to load your legs.
Explode straight upward off the floor and immediately drive both knees high up toward your chest in midair.
Bring your feet back underneath you and land quietly, bending your hips and knees to absorb the impact.
tips: Lift your knees up to your chest rather than folding your torso far downward to meet your knees.
Land quietly with knees tracking over your toes and reset briefly if your landing form starts to break down.
